title: Name a world you made
text: While you place a world you made, type a name for it. It shows on its label, its card and in search, and saves keep it. Names of real things are refused.

pictures.caption: Typing a name while placing it
Big Blue, with its new name

title: A simpler Time panel
text: One way back: a big Back to now button that shows only when you are away from now. The speed in words: Real time, 1 minute a second, 2 days a second, backwards.

pictures.caption: At real time: four buttons, the speed in words
Two days a second backwards: Back to now appears

title: Make your own worlds
text: God mode: on the Sun's card, Add now makes seven kinds of worlds of your own, each with a look of its own. While you place one: New look, Add rings, and a Colour slider. Saves and links keep it all.

pictures.caption: Add: the seven new worlds under the three from before
Six of the new kinds, just made
The same giant, its colours turned with the Colour slider

title: No surprise fast-forward after an edit
text: After a change, time stays as you had it, and the chip offers Watch: it plays what the change does until you stop it. (More, Show me what happens, brings back the automatic watch.)

title: God mode round other stars
text: Mass, Move, Throw and Remove now work on the planets of other stars, like TRAPPIST-1, with Undo and Back to reality. Pictures from the test run, before the new tab bar.

pictures.caption: Planet e made 1,000 times heavier: 7.7 days later the inner orbits are thrown about

title: A slimmer tab bar and buttons that say what they do
text: The cheap team's design: a flat tab bar and one row of keys in plain words (Turning around it, My ship). The keys step aside while a card is open, so they never cover the planet.

pictures.caption: Before: round buttons stacked, Drag: orbit
After: one row of keys that say what they do

title: Real planets, and made-up ones say so
text: Stars people know now show only the planets astronomers found. Every card says Real planet or Made-up planet, and Explore has a list of 12 real ones.

pictures.caption: Real: 51 Peg b, the first planet found around a Sun-like star
Made up: a planet the app imagines for Gl 9848, a faint star

title: God mode shows everywhere
text: Every object's card now has the same five powers. Where one can't work yet, it is dimmed, and a tap says why in a line, such as 'No measured mass for this star in our data'. Work by the cheap team (Kimi K3.1 Pro), checked and live.

title: The ship's dashboard in plain words
text: Flying, the instruments are one slim strip: speed in km/h, height above the ground in km, and a warning only when it matters. Every control is still there with plain names; the rest is one tap away. Work by the cheap team (Kimi K3.1 Pro) in two tries, checked and live.

title: Search finds the names people type
text: Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti and Eta Carinae are found now, Sol gives the Sun first and ISS the space station, and made-up planets like Vega b come up too. Work by the cheap team (GLM 5.3 Flash), with the checker's fix to the constellation names.

title: A test that visits 20 places across space
text: Every change is now checked at 20 places: planets, moons, stars, planets of other stars, black holes, a nebula and galaxies. At each it checks search, the card, Go there, tapping, the powers, Undo and share links. 141 of 144 checks pass; the other 3 wait for fixes already under way. Written by the cheap team (Kimi K3.1 Pro), checked and live.

title: Tap a galaxy where you see it
text: Tapping a galaxy now selects it: the Milky Way when you look at it from outside, and Andromeda instead of the little galaxy in front of it. Work by the cheap team (Kimi K3.1 Pro), checked and tested.

pictures.caption: Before: Milky Way tap picks another galaxy
